h1: Custom Frosted Plastic Vinyl for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Frosted Plastic Vinyl | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom frosted plastic vinyl for a soft, matte look. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Frosted plastic vinyl offers a subtle, matte finish that reduces glare and adds a tactile, premium feel to promotional items. Unlike glossy vinyl, frosted surfaces resist fingerprints and smudges, making them ideal for giveaways at trade shows or employee kits where a clean, professional appearance matters. Decorate with screen printing or debossing for a cohesive brand look on notebooks, folders, or ID holders.
heroAltText: Custom frosted plastic vinyl products with matte finish and screen printed logo, perfect for corporate giveaways
